content.content: "Starships," a 2012 single from Nicki Minaj's album "Pink Friday: Roman Reloaded," exemplifies the artist's transition into pop-dance territory. With RedOne's production, the song injects kinetic energy into an otherwise empty metaphor, showcasing Minaj's ability to craft infectious, mainstream dance-pop. Its success underscores her versatility and appeal in the early 2010s musical landscape.
